result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but one clear defect stands out: an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') is rendered as a section heading instead of human-readable text. A couple of minor styling inconsistencies were also noted in the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized label (e.g. 'Popular near you'), indicating a missing translation string or failed lookup.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation for 'home_feed.popular_title' in all supported locales and ensure the i18n fallback renders a readable default string rather than the raw key.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card it sits directly on the image with no background, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular backdrop. On light images the bare icon could become hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular background (or scrim) behind the heart icon on all cards for consistent appearance and reliable contrast.

issues.description: The ramen card shows a '€0 delivery' badge on the image and repeats '€0 delivery' in the metadata line below, creating redundant information.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery-fee badge only when it adds new information (e.g. a promo or discount), or omit the duplicate text in the metadata row.
